query: Our mobile rhythm game gives every hit a bright flash, screen shake, loud sound, and vibration. Players with photosensitivity and players who turn off haptics report discomfort. Preserve clear hit feedback while making the mechanic accessible.
expected_behavior: Preserves immediate, perceivable confirmation for hit, miss, and reward states while offering reduced-motion and haptic-off settings
Provides non-flashing visual alternatives and does not rely on color alone to communicate timing or score
Respects device sound and haptic preferences and avoids forcing those channels on the player
Keeps rhythm timing and input response within the game’s performance and latency requirements
Recommends checking the alternatives with affected players or an accessibility review rather than treating the toggle alone as proof
